risk_note: RV2 (linking/** and union/**; order attribution and user authorization). Pinduoduo open checks the filing: union gains an optional queryPddAuthority (governed only when present; demo default authorized, scenario pdd_unauthorized; real adapter placeholder). A non-active, non-blocked binding is queried first; authorized -> set active / insert an active row inside the open transaction under a savepoint through canTransitionBinding (approvals #26, including unbound -> active) and a row_version CAS, a unique-violation re-reads (no 500), pdd_custom written, attr_code used instead of user_id; not authorized -> 30111 with auth_jump; blocked and not banned -> 30153; query failure -> 50303 without writes; site authorization of the account in use unavailable -> 50301 maintenance. no_rebate skips the check and records binding_blocked server-side. Someone else's share link whose sharer is not active or blocked -> 30111 + sharer_auth_invalid without auth entry or state. JD unchanged; Taobao composition delegates to the pdd layer. Written by hand.
